name: ferry
description: Tiny zero-dependency browser utility that ferries text and rich HTML onto the clipboard

scripts.build: bun run build:modules && bun run build:cdn && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.build:modules: bun build src/index.ts --format esm --outfile dist/index.js && bun build src/index.ts --format cjs --outfile dist/index.cjs
